composio.note: Composio lists managed OAuth for Box, good for prototypes. Use your own app for branding, scopes or dedicated quota. Box MCP is a separate toolkit (BOX_MCP) that needs your own OAuth app.

need_own_app.answer: Not for a prototype, since Composio provides a managed Box app. For launch, use your own app if you need your brand on the consent screen, custom scopes, or dedicated quota.
reasons: Consent screen shows your brand instead of 'Composio wants to access your account'
Managed defaults may not include the scopes you need
Managed apps share quota across all Composio users
Box MCP toolkit requires your own OAuth app

prerequisites.title: Free Box developer account
prerequisites.detail: It gives access to the Developer Console, where apps are created.

prerequisites.title: Multi-factor authentication on your Box account
prerequisites.detail: You need it enabled to view the client secret.

steps.title: Create a User app
steps.detail: In the Developer Console, select New App and choose User as the type. This gives OAuth 2.0.
steps.done_when: The app exists with OAuth 2.0 authentication.

steps.title: Draft scopes list
steps.detail: Work out the minimum scopes your agent needs. Scopes cap what the app can request.
steps.done_when: A minimal scope list is ready.

steps.title: Copy Composio redirect URI
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

steps.title: Configure redirect URI and scopes
steps.detail: On the Configuration tab, add the redirect URI (HTTPS, exact match) and enable scopes.
steps.done_when: Redirect URI and scopes are saved.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the Composio auth config via its API with your own client ID and secret from the Configuration tab.

steps.title: Customer admin enables app
steps.detail: If a customer's enterprise leaves unpublished apps inactive, their admin must enable it.
steps.done_when: The customer's users can authorize the app.

steps.title: Submit to Box Integrations
steps.detail: Follow the Developer Console submission flow and the Box Integrations checklist.

steps.title: Box partner review
steps.detail: Box reviews the submission. Duration is not documented.

traps.title: Redirect URI must match exactly
traps.detail: A missing redirect_uri causes a redirect_uri_missing error. Mismatched URIs are rejected.

traps.title: Scope changes force re-authorization
traps.detail: Changing scopes or access level requires re-authorization, and an admin for enterprise apps.

traps.title: Refresh tokens expire and are single-use
traps.detail: A refresh token lasts 60 days and works once. Store the newest one, or the user must authorize again.

traps.title: App type cannot be changed
traps.detail: An OAuth 2.0 app cannot become a Server app; create a new one if needed.

blockers.symptom: Customer users cannot authorize the app
blockers.what_it_means: The customer's enterprise may leave unpublished apps inactive by default.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask the customer's Box Admin or Co-Admin to enable the app.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the request message with the client ID and app name.

blockers.what_it_means: The authorization URL lacks a redirect_uri matching a configured one.
blockers.what_to_do: Include a redirect_uri that exactly matches a registered URI.
blockers.agent_can_help: Check the registered URI against the authorization URL.
